messages:
nina_ops: Quick follow-up from the NATS flapping postmortem — duplicate pages across regions still happening in small bursts. Postmortem link: https://redwood.infra/pm/nats-flap-2026.
nina_ops: Root causes: alert fires on instantaneous maxima + no PD grouping by immutable queue id. Need concrete owners and a short rollout plan.
samira: I'll own alert expression change and canary. Plan: change to 1m p95 and a higher guardrail for noisy queues.
jordan_m: I'll own PD grouping/dedupe. Will add queue_id label and update PD grouping rules in staging first.
todd_sre: Suggest short-term mute for top 5 noisy queues for 48h while we test. I'll prepare list.
rita_ops: Current rule:
```
alert: nats_queue_backlog_high
expr: max_over_time(nats_queue_backlog[30s]) > 100
labels:
  severity: pager
```
rita_ops: Proposed fixes:
- change expr -> quantile_over_time(0.95, nats_queue_backlog[1m]) >= 250
- add label: queue_id and queue_hash for PD grouping
- suppression: max 1 page per queue_id per 10m unless backlog >= 2000
samira: Action items:
- A1: Alert expr + bypass rule PR (owner: samira, due: 2026-03-26)
- A2: PD grouping + dedupe label (owner: jordan_m, due: 2026-03-25)
- A3: Short-term mute list (owner: todd_sre, due: 2026-03-24)
- A4: Runbook + dashboard update (owner: rita_ops, due: 2026-03-27)
jordan_m: Scheduling note: I'll push PD change during 03-25 maintenance window and run synthetic across eu/us.
todd_sre: Mute list ready, will coordinate with samira to avoid hiding true incidents.
rita_ops: I'll add pages_per_queue_1h and suppressed_pages metric to the dashboard. Success metric: >=75% drop in duplicate pages for noisy queues and no >10% regression in backlog p95.
 oncall-bot: Retro board updated: https://redwood.infra/retro/PM-420. Calendar invite set for verification on 2026-03-29 16:00 UTC.
samira: Opening WIP PR now: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/503. Will tag eng-runtime for quick review.
nina_ops: Thanks all. If canary shows missed alerts, rollback plan is immediate revert + notify #eng-oncall.
